name: @w6w-apps/airtop
description: Drive real, cloud-hosted browsers with Airtop's AI browser automation: create sessions and windows, load and interact with pages, and extract structured data with natural-language prompts.

w6w.longDescription:
Airtop runs real Chromium browser sessions in the cloud and drives them with an AI layer, so a workflow can automate sites that have no API: log in, click, type, scroll, upload files, and read back what's on the page — either verbatim or as an answer to a natural-language question.

A session is the cloud browser itself; a window is one tab inside it. Every interaction (click, hover, type, scroll, screenshot, scrape, page query, paginated extraction, summarize, file input) targets a window and is described in plain language — "the login button", "the search box in the top right" — rather than a CSS selector, so it keeps working when a site's markup changes. Profiles persist cookies and local storage across sessions (e.g. to stay logged in), and the Files API moves a file in or out of a session's browser.

This app covers exactly the surface Airtop's own OpenAPI document (`api.airtop.ai/api/openapi.json`) marks as its stable, publicly documented API (`x-fern-audiences: public`). Airtop also exposes a newer `act` / `extract` / `find-one` / `find-many` / `navigate` / `wait-for-page` / `llm` interface under `/v2/sessions/.../windows/...`, and an `Agents` / `GTM Engineer` / `Knowledge Base` product surface under `/v2/agents`, `/v2/gtm-engineer`, `/v2/organizations/.../knowledge-base` and related paths — both are left out of this app and explained in the README, rather than guessed at.
